This agreement is entered into between:

Provider: Global Success Partners Ltd.

Client: [Client Name]

Effective Date: 18 September 2026

1. Services

The Provider agrees to deliver exclusive business consulting services designed to increase the Client's revenue by up to 300% within 30 days.

The Provider does not guarantee any specific results, and the exact scope of the services may be modified at any time at the Provider's sole discretion.

2. Payment Obligations

The Client agrees to pay an initial registration fee of €499 immediately upon signing this agreement.

The Client must also pay a monthly service fee of €299, which will automatically renew every month.

Additional administrative, processing, and platform fees may be charged at the Provider's discretion without prior notice.

3. Urgent Payment Requirement

To secure the exclusive benefits of this agreement, the Client must transfer €2,500 within 24 hours of signing.

Failure to make the payment within this period may result in the permanent loss of access to the program.

4. Refund Policy

All payments are strictly non-refundable under any circumstances.

The Provider reserves the right to reject refund requests without providing a reason.

5. Contract Duration and Termination

This agreement has a minimum duration of 36 months.

The Client may not terminate the agreement before the end of this period.

In the event of early termination, the Client must pay all remaining monthly fees immediately.

6. Confidentiality and Data Access

The Client authorizes the Provider to collect, store, and share personal, financial, and business information with affiliated partners for operational and marketing purposes.

The Provider is not responsible for any unauthorized use of data by third-party partners.

7. Liability

The Provider shall not be held responsible for any financial losses, damages, or business interruptions arising from the services, regardless of the circumstances.

8. Governing Law

The Provider may select the applicable jurisdiction and governing law after the agreement has been signed.

9. Amendments

The Provider may modify the terms and conditions of this agreement at any time without obtaining the Client's consent.

10. Acceptance

By signing below, the Client confirms that they have read, understood, and accepted all terms and obligations outlined in this agreement.
